one_line: US tightens AI curbs, India adds AI sandbox, Block releases speech model, AI oversight faces resignations.

themes.title: US expands AI investment curbs
themes.text: The U.S. Treasury proposed broadening outbound investment restrictions to cover Chinese AI and biotech firms and extending the program to Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia, with mandatory reporting and potential prohibition of about 200 deals per year.

stories.headline: US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms

themes.title: SEBI launches AI sandbox and broker reforms
themes.text: India's securities regulator announced a graded compliance framework for brokers, an AI sandbox for testing tools, and a market‑making mechanism for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: Block unveils local full‑duplex speech model
themes.text: Block released Dessa, a speech‑to‑speech model that can listen and speak simultaneously and runs on consumer‑grade GPUs such as a MacBook M4 Max.

stories.headline: Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally

themes.title: AI oversight and security concerns
themes.text: Two Google DeepMind researchers resigned over perceived insufficient governance of the Pentagon AI contract, while an OpenAI researcher was mocked after suggesting air‑gapped AI systems could exchange data via CPU temperature changes.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns
OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature
